rationale: The original long thesis relied on price holding above the 9-EMA and session VWAP while showing relative strength, but BIPC has now slipped below both the 5m 9-EMA ($41.71) and session VWAP ($41.66) with the current quote ($41.61/$41.64) trading beneath the last print of $41.65. Concurrently, the broader market has deteriorated significantly from SPY -1.12% at entry to -1.59% now, pulling BIPC down through consecutive lower 1-minute closes. Exiting now prevents taking the full loss down to the $41.58 hard invalidation as momentum and technical support have clearly broken down.
